abstract: We present an uncalibrated Tier-1 per-respondent simulation approach for predicting responses to 16 climate communication interventions and a control condition. We construct 18,000 synthetic U.S. personas by sampling a joint demographic distribution constrained by Census, CPS, and Pew pairwise statistics, and balance their assignment across the 17 conditions. Using QSTN and Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B, we present each persona, assigned intervention, and the full questionnaire in a single battery prompt. The model reports a probability distribution over response ranges for every survey item. We sample directly from the normalized model probabilities without temperature calibration, then make seeded grid-heaped draws within the selected slider bins and compute the required composite outcomes.
